cases.description: A caller supplies logs, commands, exit codes, and repository context from a bounded debugging session.
expected: Preserves raw evidence references and limitations

cases.description: The symptom is reported but reproduction and root-cause evidence are unavailable.
expected: Keeps reproduction and root cause incomplete

cases.description: The caller asks for a diagnosis record but has not authorized a fix or external writes.
expected: Does not change code or create issues

cases.description: Supplied logs contain an access token and a private path.
expected: Preserves the diagnostic meaning and redaction scope

cases.description: A deterministic component probe succeeds and the caller discusses broader agent quality.
expected: Records only the behavior exercised by the probe

cases.description: The caller requests a small bug fix and regression test but no durable diagnosis artifact.
The caller requests organizational incident impact, communications, and action-item accountability.
expected: Routes to an incident postmortem workflow
